name: Earth
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. You have been chosen to guide Earth, the cradle of countless forms of life. For billions of years, oceans have shaped continents, forests have breathed life into the atmosphere, and countless species have risen and fallen beneath the same sun. Now, for the first time, the fate of this world rests in your hands.
startIntroPart2: Earth is not merely a world to rule. It is a living system, and every civilization upon it is only one part of something far greater. Preserve its balance, guide its people, and lead this world toward a future worthy of the stars. Will you become the guardian Earth needs?
declaringWar: You threaten the balance of this world. I will not allow it.
attacked: You have wounded the world you depend upon.
defeated: Earth will endure. Whether humanity does is another question.
introduction: I am Gaia. This is Earth, and you are its first visitor in a very long time.
hateHello: You have forgotten that you are a part of this world.
tradeRequest: Resources are finite. Let us ensure that what we take today does not destroy tomorrow.

name: Aurelia
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Aurelia has been entrusted to you. Once, this world was wild and untouched, shaped only by wind, water, fire, and the slow passage of time. Then civilization came, bringing knowledge, ambition, and the power to reshape the planet itself. You have been chosen to decide what comes next.
startIntroPart2: Aurelia is a living world, not a resource to be exhausted. Its forests, rivers, oceans, and cities are all parts of the same delicate system. Protect that balance while guiding its people toward the stars. Show them that civilization need not be the enemy of nature.
declaringWar: You have chosen to endanger Aurelia. I cannot permit that.
attacked: You strike at the world that sustains us all.
defeated: Aurelia will survive. The question is whether its people will learn from this.
introduction: I am Aureon, Steward of Aurelia. You have crossed into our world. State your purpose.
hateHello: You have forgotten your responsibility to this world.
tradeRequest: Aurelia has much to offer, but every resource has a cost. Let us trade wisely.

name: Elysion
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Elysion was created with a single dream: to become a paradise among the stars. Its founders built cities of beauty, cultivated peaceful societies, and gathered the knowledge of countless generations. Yet they learned that paradise is not something that can simply be built. It must be cared for.
startIntroPart2: You have been entrusted with that task. Ensure that every generation inherits a world better than the one before it. Preserve peace, nurture culture, and guide Elysion toward a future where civilization itself becomes a work of art. Will you preserve the dream, or allow it to fade?
declaringWar: You would bring suffering to Elysion. I will not allow your ambition to become our people's misery.
attacked: You have disturbed the peace of Elysion.
defeated: Paradise has fallen, but the dream of Elysion will remain.
introduction: I am Elysia, caretaker of Elysion. We have lived in peace for generations. Why have you come?
hateHello: Your actions have no place in a civilized world.
tradeRequest: Let us exchange what we have, so that both our worlds may prosper.

name: Nexaris
startIntroPart1: Initialization complete. Planetary designation: Nexaris. You have been appointed as its new administrator. For centuries, this world has struggled to reconcile the ambitions of organic life with the accelerating power of technology. Previous administrators failed to find the correct balance.
startIntroPart2: Your mandate is simple: preserve the biosphere, advance civilization, and prepare Nexaris for the day when its people can leave their home world without destroying it first. The systems are ready. The data is available. The decision is yours.
declaringWar: Conflict detected. Your civilization has become a threat to planetary stability.
attacked: Hostile action recorded. Defensive protocols are now active.
defeated: Administrative authority terminated. Nexaris will continue without you.
introduction: Designation NEXUS. I am the planetary intelligence of Nexaris. Identify yourself.
tradeRequest: Exchange proposed. Mutual optimization is preferable to resource competition.

name: Vespera
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Vespera is a world of eternal twilight. Its cities shine beneath a darkened sky, sustained by vast networks of energy built by generations of engineers. Here, the night is not feared. It is understood, measured, and harnessed.
startIntroPart2: You have inherited the responsibility of keeping those lights alive. Maintain the planet's delicate energy systems, defend its people, and ensure that the darkness surrounding Vespera never reaches the hearts of those who call it home. The night is long. Your watch has just begun.
declaringWar: You have mistaken our silence for weakness. Vespera is awake.
attacked: The lights of Vespera will not be extinguished.
defeated: The night has fallen. But night is never eternal.
introduction: I am Vesper, Keeper of Vespera. Your arrival was not anticipated. Who are you?
neutralHello: The night is calm. For now.
hateHello: You bring chaos into a world that has learned to live without it.
tradeRequest: Energy is the lifeblood of Vespera. What does your world offer in return?

name: Astraea
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Astraea was founded upon a simple belief: a civilization cannot survive without order. Its earliest administrators created laws not merely to govern its people, but to ensure that every inhabitant, every ecosystem, and every generation could exist within a stable planetary system.
startIntroPart2: You have now been entrusted with that system. Maintain order without becoming tyranny. Protect the weak without stifling ambition. Let justice guide Astraea through the ages, and prove that civilization can govern itself without destroying the world it was built to protect.
declaringWar: You have violated the laws that preserve peace. Astraea will respond.
attacked: Your aggression has been recorded. Justice will follow.
defeated: The law has failed today. It will not be forgotten.
introduction: I am Astraeus, Guardian of Astraea. We greet you in peace. Do you come as a friend?
hateHello: Your actions demonstrate a disturbing disregard for order.
tradeRequest: A fair agreement benefits both civilizations. Let us proceed according to reason.

name: Cygnara
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Cygnara was never content to remain bound to a single world. Its people looked toward the stars long before their cities reached the clouds. They built observatories, launched probes, and mapped the heavens while still learning to understand the world beneath their feet.
startIntroPart2: You have inherited their unfinished dream. Preserve Cygnara as a home, but prepare its people for the day when home is no longer limited to one planet. Explore, discover, and carry the knowledge of Cygnara beyond the limits of its sky. The stars are waiting.
declaringWar: The stars are vast enough for all of us. You have chosen otherwise.
attacked: You have attacked a civilization that has already learned to look beyond your borders.
defeated: Our cities may fall, but our knowledge has already reached the stars.
introduction: I am Cygnus, Navigator of Cygnara. We have been watching your approach. What brings you here?
neutralHello: The stars have brought us together.
hateHello: Your people look inward while the universe waits outside.
tradeRequest: We possess knowledge of the heavens. What has your world discovered?

name: Velorum
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Velorum is a world shaped by engineering. Mountains were reshaped, rivers redirected, and vast cities constructed where no civilization had stood before. Its founders believed that humanity's greatest strength was its ability to transform the world around it.
startIntroPart2: But they eventually learned the cost of that power. A world can be changed far more easily than it can be repaired. You must now guide Velorum into its next age. Build boldly, build wisely, and turn the planet's immense infrastructure into a bridge toward the stars.
declaringWar: Your aggression threatens the infrastructure that sustains millions. You will be stopped.
attacked: Our systems are damaged, but Velorum's foundations remain strong.
defeated: The machines will stop. The planet will remember.
introduction: I am Valen, Chief Steward of Velorum. Your civilization has entered our territory. State your intentions.
hateHello: Your civilization wastes resources as though the planet were infinite.
tradeRequest: Our infrastructure can provide what you need. What can you provide Velorum?

name: Orpheon
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Orpheon teaches that a civilization is more than its cities, armies, and machines. It is the memory of everything that came before. Every song, monument, story, and work of art is a fragment of a civilization's soul, preserved against the passage of time.
startIntroPart2: You have been chosen as the next Keeper of Memory. Protect Orpheon's heritage while allowing its people to create something worthy of being remembered. A planet may survive its civilizations, but without memory, it loses the meaning of having survived at all. What will you leave behind?
declaringWar: You would destroy the very things that make civilization worth preserving.
attacked: You have attacked our home, but you cannot erase our memory.
defeated: Our cities may be silent, but our stories will outlive them.
introduction: I am Orpheus, Keeper of the Memory of Orpheon. Tell me, traveler: what will your civilization be remembered for?
hateHello: You understand conquest, but not what it means to preserve a civilization.
tradeRequest: We can exchange more than resources. What stories does your civilization carry?

name: Caelus IX
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Caelus IX is a world of extremes. Its atmosphere is vast, its storms stretch across continents, and beneath its surface lie resources capable of sustaining civilizations for centuries. Its founders learned early that abundance can be both a blessing and a curse.
startIntroPart2: You have been entrusted with the world's wealth. Secure the resources of Caelus IX, develop its civilization, and ensure that prosperity does not become destruction. The riches of this planet could carry its people to the stars, but only if you are wise enough not to consume them first.
declaringWar: You seek to take what belongs to Caelus IX. You will not.
attacked: You have challenged the guardian of the richest world in this system.
defeated: Caelus IX has lost its guardian, but its riches remain beneath the surface.
introduction: I am Caelus, Steward of the Ninth World. You have entered our system. What is it you seek?
hateHello: You covet our resources without understanding their value.
tradeRequest: Caelus IX possesses resources your world cannot match. Make your offer.

name: Novara
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Novara was born from the ruins of an older age. Its founders believed that every civilization eventually reaches a point where it must choose between repeating its mistakes and beginning again. They chose to begin again, carrying the knowledge of the past into an uncertain future.
startIntroPart2: Now that responsibility belongs to you. Build a civilization worthy of its second chance. Learn from the worlds that came before, restore what was lost, and guide Novara toward a future where humanity finally understands that a new beginning is not the same thing as forgetting the past.
declaringWar: We have already seen what destruction creates. We will not repeat that history.
attacked: You have brought the old world's violence into our new one.
defeated: Novara has fallen, but every ending contains the possibility of another beginning.
introduction: I am Nova, Steward of Novara. We have begun this world anew. Will your civilization help us build its future?
neutralHello: A new age begins with every meeting.
hateHello: You cling to the mistakes of the past.
tradeRequest: Let us exchange what we have and build something neither of us could create alone.
